cases.mechanism_detail: A ~2.1-kb 5'-truncated, inverted L1 (poly-T end on the NF1 strand) inserted 32 bases downstream of exon 15 causes skipping of exon 15 (frameshift); the mutant transcript is weak, suggesting reduced/skewed expression of the mutant allele. Segregates in father and two siblings.
cases.quote: Genomic analysis on gDNA and cDNA in siblings detected a 2.1 Kb insertion of part of the LINE-1 sequence within intron 15, which resulted in exon 15 skipping.
